entries.author: PHOTIUS CONSTANTINOPOLITANUS PATRIARCHA
entries.title: Myriobiblon sive Bibliotheca (codd. 250-280)
entries.note: Elenchus prints no column for this item (only two detached numbers, 1383 and 1441, at the end of the list). Body col from OCR, matched against the closing Ordo Rerum. Head 'PHOTII / MYRIOBIBLON SIVE BIBLIOTHECA. (CONTINUATIO)' at lines 285-291, then Greek and Latin of Cod. CCL (Agatharchides). The colMap starts at col 12 and the first page's number is lost; col 9 is the first column of the Ordo (first chapter listed at 9, and the page before the OCR's '12' header is 11|12 with 9|10 preceding). Runs to col 429 (Codd. 250-280); Hoeschel's Notae at col 356 and 'Ad Bibliothecam Photii' at 429 are not separate Elenchus items.
